gloss: to miss; to skip; to fail to do

definitions.gloss: to miss; to skip; to fail to do
definitions.explanation: To fail to do something that should be done regularly. Almost always used in the negative form 欠かさない (to never miss/skip).

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{毎日|まいにち}{散歩|さんぽ}を{欠|か}かさない。
examples.english: My grandfather never misses his daily walk.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しくても、{日課|にっか}だけは{欠|か}かさないようにしている。
examples.english: Even when I'm busy, I make sure to never skip my daily routine.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}コーヒーを{欠|か}かさない。
examples.english: I never skip my morning coffee.

notes:
USAGE: Almost exclusively used in the negative form {欠|か}かさない or {欠|か}かさず (without fail).

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜を{欠|か}かさない (to never miss ~)
・{欠|か}かさず〜する (to do ~ without fail)
・{一日|いちにち}も{欠|か}かさず (without missing a single day)

RELATED WORDS:
・{欠|か}ける (to lack; to be missing - intransitive)
・{欠|けっ}{席|せき}する (to be absent)
